scope: Contextual audit of the 23 linked rules, 16 linked situations, 21 linked intent concepts and six linked conditions; additionally reviewed all 97 published situation definitions for missing adoption/defect triggers. No claim of exhausting unrelated rule or intent catalogs.

remove_rule_links.reason: New-project roadmap creation rule does not generally govern recovery of an already established project.
Before-mutation repository inspection rule is not generally applicable to a read-only interruption diagnosis request.
Before-mutation rule should not apply to read-only verification of assistant claims.

pending_ontology_questions.finding: Existing selected situations do not directly model adoption of a partially completed project; keep conditional general links until separately reviewed.
Existing selected situations cover implementation change and testing, not a general defect report; keep conditional links until separately reviewed.

full_published_situation_review.finding: No published generic existing-project-adoption or user-reported-software-defect trigger exists in the 97 situation definitions.
full_published_situation_review.action: Keep relevant conditional links. Canonical ontology publication is a separate authorization decision.
